user.title: Weather station
user.description: Select the entities providing weather data used to calculate ET0 and monitor rainfall.

data.rain_sensor: Rainfall - cumulative counter / total rain (mm, NEVER resets)
data.weather_entity: Weather service entity (weather.*) - the integration will fetch the rain forecast itself
data.weather_forecast_hours: How many upcoming forecast hours to sum (mm)
data.weather_forecast_interval_min: How often to poll the weather service for the forecast (min, independent of other sensors)
data.rain_detected_sensor: Fast rain detector (binary_sensor OR a plain mm/h sensor, e.g. sensor.your_weather_station_rain_rate) - speeds up reaction during watering
data.rain_rate_threshold_mmh: Rain intensity threshold (mm/h) for a numeric rain sensor
data.rain_skip_threshold_mm: Rain threshold for SKIPPING watering entirely (mm)
data.start_mode: Mode for determining watering start time relative to sunrise
data.start_offset_min: Offset in minutes (used for 'before/after sunrise' modes)
data.rain_pause_threshold_mm: Rain threshold that triggers a pause DURING watering (mm)
data.rain_pause_check_interval_min: How often to check rainfall while running/paused (min)
data.rain_pause_max_wait_min: How long to wait before giving up on confirming the rain has stopped and resuming ANYWAY, with a reduced target (min) - the integration NEVER abandons watering purely because of how long it rains, only when the rain itself has already covered that zone's need
data.auto_mode_enabled: Enable fully automatic watering (no manual approval)
data.auto_trigger_buffer_min: Safety buffer when calculating the trigger time (min)
data.pressure_sensor: ABSOLUTE/station pressure sensor in hPa (NOT 'relative' or VPD - the name matters, not the device class/unit)
data.zone_transition_delay_sec: Delay between closing one zone and opening the next (s)
data.valve_verify_timeout_sec: How long to wait for valve open/close confirmation (s)
data.main_flow_sensor: Main flow meter - cumulative liters (default for zones without their own)
data.main_flow_rate_sensor: Main flow meter - INSTANTANEOUS flow, e.g. L/min (default for zones without their own)
data.flow_rate_zero_threshold: Below this flow value, we consider there to be no water
data.wind_skip_threshold_ms: Above this wind speed, wind-sensitive zones (sprinklers) are skipped
data.frost_threshold_c: Below this temperature, ALL watering is skipped (frost risk)
data.dynamic_mad_enabled: Dynamic MAD adjustment per FAO-56 (initial value - controlled afterwards by the "Dynamic MAD adjustment" switch entity)
data.rain_stop_confirmation_min: How many minutes of UNINTERRUPTED absence of rain are required before the integration considers the rain over and resumes watering mid-run (0 = resume after the first clean check, as before). Protects against frequently opening/closing the valve when rain falls in waves rather than continuously. If it rains longer than "Max wait time" (above), the integration resumes anyway (with a target reduced by the measured rainfall), instead of waiting forever for confirmation of quiet

When disabled: the timer/watchdog duration is exactly the calculated time for the zone, with no live extension or shortening.

data.rain_sensor: Rainfall - cumulative counter / total rain (mm, NEVER resets)
data.weather_entity: Weather service entity (weather.*) - the integration will fetch the rain forecast itself
data.weather_forecast_hours: How many upcoming forecast hours to sum (mm)
data.weather_forecast_interval_min: How often to poll the weather service for the forecast (min, independent of other sensors)
data.rain_detected_sensor: Fast rain detector (binary_sensor OR a plain mm/h sensor, e.g. sensor.your_weather_station_rain_rate) - speeds up reaction during watering
data.rain_rate_threshold_mmh: Rain intensity threshold (mm/h) for a numeric rain sensor
data.rain_skip_threshold_mm: Rain threshold for SKIPPING watering entirely (mm)
data.start_mode: Mode for determining watering start time relative to sunrise
data.start_offset_min: Offset in minutes (used for 'before/after sunrise' modes)
data.rain_pause_threshold_mm: Rain threshold that triggers a pause DURING watering (mm)
data.rain_pause_check_interval_min: How often to check rainfall while running/paused (min)
data.rain_pause_max_wait_min: How long to wait before giving up on confirming the rain has stopped and resuming ANYWAY, with a reduced target (min) - the integration NEVER abandons watering purely because of how long it rains, only when the rain itself has already covered that zone's need
data.auto_mode_enabled: Enable fully automatic watering (no manual approval)
data.auto_trigger_buffer_min: Safety buffer when calculating the trigger time (min)
data.pressure_sensor: ABSOLUTE/station pressure sensor in hPa (NOT 'relative' or VPD - the name matters, not the device class/unit)
data.zone_transition_delay_sec: Delay between closing one zone and opening the next (s)
data.valve_verify_timeout_sec: How long to wait for valve open/close confirmation (s)
data.main_flow_sensor: Main flow meter - cumulative liters (default for zones without their own)
data.main_flow_rate_sensor: Main flow meter - INSTANTANEOUS flow, e.g. L/min (default for zones without their own)
data.flow_rate_zero_threshold: Below this flow value, we consider there to be no water
data.wind_skip_threshold_ms: Above this wind speed, wind-sensitive zones (sprinklers) are skipped
data.frost_threshold_c: Below this temperature, ALL watering is skipped (frost risk)
data.dynamic_mad_enabled: Dynamic MAD adjustment per FAO-56 (initial value - controlled afterwards by the "Dynamic MAD adjustment" switch entity)
data.rain_stop_confirmation_min: How many minutes of UNINTERRUPTED absence of rain are required before the integration considers the rain over and resumes watering mid-run (0 = resume after the first clean check, as before). Protects against frequently opening/closing the valve when rain falls in waves rather than continuously. If it rains longer than "Max wait time" (above), the integration resumes anyway (with a target reduced by the measured rainfall), instead of waiting forever for confirmation of quiet

runtime_too_short.description: Zone {garden_irrigation_zone_name}: the maximum watering time is set to {configured_min} min, but fully refilling the root zone from empty (e.g. after a vacation or a series of days skipped due to rain) requires about {required_min} min. Consider raising the limit in the zone configuration (the 'Maximum watering time' field) to at least {required_min} min, with a small margin.
